_comment: Ad density and behaviour for Google AdSense, read at runtime by public/ads.js. server/index.js serves GET /ads-config.json and merges the ADS_CONFIG environment variable over the top, so this can be retuned with one Fly secret and no deploy. The AdSense loader itself (client ca-pub-6368797323385379) is in every page head and enables Auto ads, which are configured in the AdSense account, not here.
_maxSlotsPerPage: Ceiling on how many fixed slots load on one page, in the order the visitor reaches them. 0 disables the fixed slots (Auto ads are unaffected).
_types: Per-format kill switch for the fixed slots. banner follows leaderboard.
_adsense: slots maps a slot type (leaderboard, banner, box, skyscraper, native) or 'default' to an AdSense display ad-unit ID (the data-ad-slot number from AdSense -> Ads -> By ad unit). A type with no ID never loads, and Auto ads place ads instead. Fixed slots never load on app screens (.ad-card-app: start, matchmaking, call, chat) - see public/ads.js.
_pauseDuringCall: While a voice call or text chat is live, no slot starts loading or collapses, so nothing moves under a conversation.
_fillTimeoutMs: How long Google is given to fill a unit off screen / on screen before the slot gives its space to a house promo or collapses.
_fallback: What to put in a slot when the ad network never fills it - most often because the visitor runs an ad blocker or a filtering DNS resolver, which is a large share of this audience. Rather than collapsing to nothing, the slot shows one of our own promos. These are plain first-party HTML with no external request of any kind, so nothing exists for a blocker to block. Never labelled Sponsored, because they are our own content and calling them sponsored would be a lie. Set enabled:false to go back to collapsing.
